About the Bike Lafayette Saturday Community Ride group ride

Twice a month the advocacy nonprofit Bike Lafayette hosts a community ride around town. Start point and time are posted on the Bike Lafayette Facebook page. The same page lists partner rides like Lafayette Critical Mass and Krewe de Velo.
